info.name: Fetch event metrics split by view

params.name: env_id
params.description: Environment ID to use (e.g. S1234)

params.name: view_id
params.description: View to use

params.name: from
params.description: Start time of requested graph. Date in ISO8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

params.name: to
params.description: End time of requested graph. Date in ISO8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ)

params.name: points
params.description: Number of data points to return within the interval. **IMPORTANT:** either 'points' or 'resolution' parameters have to be passed. When both are passed, resolution takes precedence.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Select graph resolution (use M1/M5 for 1 point per 1/5 minutes; use H1/H8 for 1 point per 1/8 hours). **IMPORTANT:** either 'points' or 'resolution' parameters have to be passed. When both are passed, resolution takes precedence.

params.name: server
params.description: Server(s) added to the filter

params.name: app
params.description: Application(s) added to the filter

params.name: deployment
params.description: Deployment(s) added to the filter

params.name: stats
params.description: Include statistics per event in the response
